probes: SELECT c.relname, c.relkind::text, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('Stock_List', 'Stock_List_Member', 'Stock_List_Member_History', 'Stock_List_Load_Log', 'Stock_List_By_Ticker') ORDER BY 1
SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text, p.prosecdef, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), p.proconfig FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid = to_regprocedure('public.apply_stock_list_snapshot(jsonb, uuid)')
SELECT data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'Monitoring_Stockbit_Update' AND column_name = 'stock_lists'
